note: Both sets capture the two figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0° = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336°) and both contain duplicated claims and one truncated unit (watt/ra). Set A labels the 6.302336° value only vaguely as 'theta (θ)', which is imprecise but not contradicted by the page, whereas Set B misbinds it as the 'best-fit line intercept', which the text explicitly defines as the second term in square brackets of Eq. (7-16a) — not θK. Since θK is defined as the blade-pitch angle at which pitch sensitivity has doubled, Set B introduces a misread property binding that Set A avoids.
